reason: The text describes Yahweh's anger directed at the people's disobedience—specifically their refusal to obey the command not to gather manna on the Sabbath. They went out on the seventh day to gather despite explicit instructions (verse 4: 'on the seventh day there will be none'). Yahweh's complaint to Moses is 'How long will you refuse to keep my commandments and my teachings?' The anger is triggered by their failure to observe the Sabbath law through their actions, not by them voicing opinions or feelings. There is no mention in the text of the people expressing their opinions or feelings; rather, the issue is their active disobedience.
